value.name: house closes in late April
value.description: The house is described as having closed in late April, marking a major property transition.

value.name: Asha delivers final papers
value.description: Asha comes to the house one last time to bring the final papers needed to complete the transfer.
evidence: Asha came to the house one last time to deliver the final papers.

value.name: Lucia appears in her own clothes
value.description: Lucia opens the door wearing her own clothes instead of her mother's, signaling a personal shift.
evidence: Lucia opened the door. She was wearing her own clothes now, not her mother's.

value.name: camel coat is given away
value.description: Lucia explains that the camel coat has been removed from the foyer and given to a neighbor who admired it for years.
evidence: The camel coat was gone from the rack in the foyer, given, Lucia said, to a woman down the block who had admired it for fifteen years.

value.name: Rosa resumes making coffee
value.description: Rosa is back at the stove making coffee on her own schedule rather than the family's.
evidence: Rosa was at the stove, making coffee, which she had begun doing again on a schedule that was now her own and not the family's.

value.name: Lucia keeps Rosa on privately
value.description: Lucia asks Rosa to stay on two afternoons a week, and Rosa agrees only if Lucia pays her personally rather than from the estate.
evidence: Lucia had asked her to stay on, two afternoons a week, for as long as she wanted, and Rosa had accepted on the condition that she be paid out of Lucia's pocket and not the estate's

value.name: Asha understands Rosa's condition
value.description: Asha initially does not understand the payment distinction but then fully grasps its meaning.
evidence: which was a distinction Asha had not understood at first and had then understood entirely.

value.name: Asha declares the transfer complete
value.description: Asha slides the papers across the table and tells Lucia that everything is done.
evidence: "It's done," Asha said, sliding the papers across.

value.name: Lucia confirms ownership
value.description: Lucia repeats that the process is done and acknowledges that she now owns the house.

"You own this house."

value.name: Lucia plans to live in the house
value.description: Lucia looks around the kitchen and decides she will live there, moving her work into the house and reshaping family routines.
evidence: "I am going to live in it," she said.
